issue.title: Stop the Sync icon flashing pending before All synced [Returning online and sync changes Audit]
issue.body:
Found during the returning online and synchronizing changes audit (#530, epic #526). First seen during PR #563 device QA.

**Severity:** Low  
**Launch blocker:** No  
**Confirmed on:** Xiaomi Redmi Note 9 Pro, Android 10 (API 29), local debug build of `ddfdaaa` (PR #559 head), `dev.api.fluent.bible`

## Summary

After Sync Now finishes, the large Sync icon briefly returns to "pending" before showing "All synced". On `complete` / `idle`, `isUploading` is set to false right away while the pending counts still hold the value from before the upload; the fresh counts arrive only when the async SQLite refresh resolves. PR #606 keeps the same order (`syncStatusStore.ts:155-160` commits first, `refreshSyncStatusStore()` runs after).

## Expected

"Syncing…" goes straight to "All synced".

## Actual

The icon flashes pending for a moment, then shows "All synced".

## Steps to reproduce

1. Record a few verse takes.
2. Open Sync and tap Sync Now; watch the large icon when the upload ends.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No snapshot has `isUploading: false` with the pre-upload `pendingCount` after `complete` / `idle`.
- [ ] Unit test: `complete` emitted before the pending query resolves → no pending state in between.
- [ ] Android device QA.

## Related

- Parent audit: #530 (epic #526)
- #603 / PR #606 (same code path)
- Assessment: `docs/assessments/returning-online-and-sync/README.md` (PR #598)
